ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: My choice was driven by capability fit. The query is a demanding, long-form SEO content task — writing an in-depth keyword-optimized article. Willet-235B scores meaningfully higher on Creative Generation (84.7 vs 78.8, a >2-point gap beyond run-to-run variance) and on the writing-relevant public benchmarks (Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 81.4, IFEval 89.8 vs 85.6). The content is benign, so the moderation/distasteful-content preference profiles that distinguish the two models don't apply here, leaving raw capability as the deciding factor in Willet's favor.
